annotations.title: Build GovCon Oral Presentation Deck, Live Tech-Demo Runbook & Murder-Board Q&A

description: Generate a FAR 15.102 & Shipley Phase-II Oral Presentation slide-by-slide blueprint, Key Personnel speaker-attributed talking points, a minute-by-minute Live Technical Demonstration / Scenario Challenge runbook with zero-downtime failover contingencies, an adversarial SSEB 'Murder Board' Q&A coaching matrix, and evaluator caucus takeaways from RFP Section L/M oral instructions. This is a read-only, stateless generative preparation call (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `rfp_oral_instructions_and_sow_text` accepts 30 to 120,000 characters, `proposed_solution_and_key_personnel` maps slides strictly to eligible Key Personnel speakers, optional `known_incumbent_and_risk_areas` sharpens Murder-Board trap questions, and `presentation_format_mode` selects 'COMBINED_ORALS_TECH_DEMO_AND_QA' [default], 'EXECUTIVE_SLIDE_BRIEFING_AND_QA', 'LIVE_TECHNICAL_SCENARIO_CHALLENGE', or 'KEY_PERSONNEL_INTERVIEW_AND_CAUCUS'). Use this tool when preparing for Phase-II advisory down-select oral presentations, live technical demonstrations, or SSEB Q&A caucuses; use `generate_rfp_response` instead for written Volume I Technical Approach prose, or `match_key_personnel` for written Volume II resumes and Letters of Commitment.

known_incumbent_and_risk_areas.description: Optional competitive context, incumbent vulnerabilities, transition risks, or technical gaps where the Source Selection Evaluation Board (SSEB) is likely to probe during Murder-Board Q&A.

presentation_format_mode.description: Oral presentation format mode: 'COMBINED_ORALS_TECH_DEMO_AND_QA' (default, slide deck + live technical demo + Q&A), 'EXECUTIVE_SLIDE_BRIEFING_AND_QA' (Shipley slide deck + Q&A), 'LIVE_TECHNICAL_SCENARIO_CHALLENGE' (on-the-spot engineering problem/coding challenge), or 'KEY_PERSONNEL_INTERVIEW_AND_CAUCUS' (structured SSEB oral interview).

proposed_solution_and_key_personnel.description: Proposed technical/management solution architecture, key discriminators, and named Key Personnel speakers (roles, clearances, domain expertise, and past performance proof points) who will present.

rfp_oral_instructions_and_sow_text.description: Raw RFP Section L Oral Presentation / Live Tech-Demo rules (time limits, slide limits, speaker eligibility restrictions under FAR 15.102, live scenario prompts), Section M evaluation criteria, and PWS/SOW technical scope (30 to 120,000 characters).

name: generate_oral_presentation_prep

evaluator_caucus_takeaways.description: Verbatim strengths designed for SSEB evaluators to record on consensus scoring sheets.

live_tech_demo_runbook.description: Minute-by-minute live technical demonstration runbook with operator actions, telemetry proof, and backup failover plans.

murder_board_qa_matrix.description: Adversarial SSEB Murder-Board questions paired with Answer-First-Elaborate-Anchor responses and trap-avoidance rules.

predicted_oral_confidence_rating.description: Predicted DoD/Federal Source Selection Oral Confidence rating (e.g., High Confidence / Outstanding).

slide_deck_blueprint.description: Slide-by-slide Shipley oral presentation deck with assigned Key Personnel speaker, time budget, visual layout, and talking points.

title: Build GovCon Oral Presentation Deck, Live Tech-Demo Runbook & Murder-Board Q&A
